info.title: Youjaymharah custom API
info.description:
Endpoints added by this project, on top of the Medusa Store and Admin APIs.

Medusa's own routes (products, carts, orders, customers, returns, ...) are
documented separately and can be downloaded from:

- Store: https://docs.medusajs.com/api/download/store
- Admin: https://docs.medusajs.com/api/download/admin

Every /store route also requires the `x-publishable-api-key` header.
Admin routes marked with `x-required-policies` need those RBAC policies,
which the Store Manager and Marketing roles already hold.

post.description: Public. Always answers the same way whether the address is new, pending or already subscribed, so membership cannot be probed.
Takes the single-use token from the confirmation email.
Takes the token from the unsubscribe link in any newsletter email.

Call this with the token from GET /auth/customer/{provider}/callback instead of POST /store/customers. If the provider-verified email already has an account, the sign-in method is attached to it and that customer is returned (`linked: true`); otherwise a new customer is created. Only providers that verify email ownership (currently Google) may link; an emailpass identity is rejected.

200.description: The customer this sign-in now belongs to.

400.description: The sign-in returned no email address.

403.description: This sign-in method may not be linked to an existing account.

post.summary: Set a password on an account that has none
post.description: For customers who signed up with Google and want to sign in with a password too. The email is taken from the logged-in account, not the request. Refused when the account already has a password — that is a reset, not a set.

400.description: The password is shorter than 8 characters.

403.description: This account already has a password; use the reset flow instead.

get.description: IDs only: load product details through /store/products so region pricing and publish status apply. Returns an empty list before the customer's first save.

post.summary: Save a product to the wishlist
post.description: One entry per product. Saving a product that is already saved does nothing, except that `variant_id` replaces the variant stored before, so the entry follows the customer's latest colour/size choice.

400.description: Validation failed, or the variant is not part of the product.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the wishlist

404.description: No such item on this customer's wishlist. Another customer's item reads as not found, so item IDs cannot be probed.
